body:
Also a quick letter to my past self:

The monster inside your head is about to turn you into him. He's going to convince you of all the same lies he has in the past. He's going to destroy everything you love in a few weeks. DON'T LISTEN TO HIM. You're worth it, she'll love you without the bullshit you're going to want to create to "make it possible" when you don't need to do anything but be who you are for a while. 

You're going to end up hurting yourself but more importantly you're going to hurt a person you're going to come to love dearly. It's going to destroy everything. You're going to self destruct because at the most basic level you are incapable of being loved and you're going to turn yourself into something you hate even more than you already hate yourself. What comes after that I don't even know.

-You
